subject: general
question: T is the daughter of A. A is married to M. M is the son of K. K is married to J. J is the father of D. D is the brother of N. G is the son of N. How is K related to T?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given: 

1) T is the daughter of A.

2) A is married to M.

3) M is the son of K.

4) K is married to J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8cef6aa566b0c9b145c2a71ecd3206d3ae168bc909b49b718dbdf32d8fccdce2.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77e3ea9e6ca970ebac5238f21f986e785bbb1310f201d1277dd67356416fff2e.png] 

5) J is the father of D.

6) D is the brother of N.

7) G is the son of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6451de718a0e99800c5e62d1c556f045838e696e56a5414fc4e372b33db6cfad.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10719e43d077f3a9c2df63209524ee20c8c1132093df5577a1ccd38d091aabb9.png] 

Thus, K is T's father's mother.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"
